title: tracing.config
description: Project tracing configuration: constrains fields and allowed values for tracing.config.json.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Asia/Shanghai, America/New_York) or fixed offset (e.g. +08:00, UTC+8, -05:30). Omitted defaults to Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8).

language.description: Output language for the daily report markdown. Omitted defaults to en-US.

targets.description: List of tracing targets; executed in order.

strategy.description: Version subscription: GET the remote version and compare it to basicVersion.

name.description: Optional display name; included in the daily report.

versionUrl.description: URL of the version resource; must be reachable via GET.

versionSource.description: plain: response body is a plain-text version string; json: response is JSON and requires versionField.

versionField.description: Required when versionSource is json. Dot paths and array indices are supported, e.g. package.version, a.b[0].c, items[1].tag.

basicVersion.description: Baseline version in npm-like form (optional v prefix or -beta suffix; comparison normalizes per project rules).

strategy.description: Git tracing: new commits on the given branch after basicCommit.

repoUrl.description: Remote repository clone URL (https or git).

basicCommit.description: Baseline commit (full or short SHA); commits after this are treated as updates.
